buyerRegister.title: Mineral Buyer Registration
buyerRegister.subtitle: Register as an approved buyer to bid on minerals listed by this mine
buyerRegister.legalNote: In line with South African law — including the Financial Intelligence Centre Act (FICA), the Precious Metals Act, the Diamonds Act, and POPIA — all buyers must be identified, vetted, and approved before bidding on any mineral listing. Provide accurate information and supporting documentation; incomplete or false submissions will be rejected.
buyerRegister.licenseHint: Required if you deal in precious metals, precious stones, or other regulated minerals under South African law. Leave blank if not applicable.
buyerRegister.documents: Upload documents (ID/registration, proof of address, dealer license, tax clearance)
buyerRegister.documentsHint: Required. Accepted formats: images and PDF.
buyerRegister.declarationsIntro: Required declarations, in line with South African law:
buyerRegister.popiaDeclaration: I consent to the processing and storage of my personal information for buyer vetting and compliance purposes, in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).
buyerRegister.ficaDeclaration: I declare that the information and documentation provided is true and complete, for the purposes of identity verification under the Financial Intelligence Centre Act (FICA).
buyerRegister.amlDeclaration: I confirm that the funds I will use to purchase minerals are from a lawful source and not connected to money laundering or the financing of terrorism.
buyerRegister.successBody: Thank you. Your application has been submitted for review. You will be able to bid on mineral listings once your registration has been approved. You can check your status by contacting the mine directly.
buyerRegister.submitError: Registration failed. Please check your details and try again.
